skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature and role of managerial accounting, distinguish between managerial and financial accounting, and analyze cost-volume-profit relationships.
Analyze cost structures, break-even points, and profit targets.
Develop cost standards and production budgeting systems.
Use cost-volume-profit analysis to support business decisions.
Effective in working independently and in teams.
Demonstrate self-motivation and responsibility for personal learning outcomes.
